subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the assertion repairs, should OpenClaw accept the newly pinned revisions for Codex, app-token, Docker, builder, and CodeQL actions that execute with credentials or elevated permissions?
rationale: The assertion changes are mechanical, but CI cannot decide whether the newly trusted third-party revisions are acceptable for OpenClaw's credentialed workflows.

options.title: Approve after source review
options.body: Repair the assertions, inspect the upstream revisions, rebase, and accept the pins after exact-head workflow and security gates pass.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Land setup-only action bumps separately and review credentialed or security-scanning actions in focused PRs.

options.title: Retain current pins
options.body: Hold the grouped bump until SecOps and workflow owners can complete the trust review.

recommendation.title: Approve after source review
recommendation.body: Repair the assertions, inspect the upstream revisions, rebase, and accept the pins after exact-head workflow and security gates pass.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes the principal security-sensitive workflow surfaces in this PR to this team.
